parsed_output.deduplication_rule: Primary key: Normalized DOI (lowercase, resolver prefix removed). Secondary key: Title + Authors + Year. If primary keys match, records are duplicates. If primary keys differ but secondary keys match exactly, flag for manual review.

workflow_steps.verification: Check that all non-null DOIs are lowercase and stripped of 'https://doi.org/' prefixes.
Group records by normalized DOI. Verify C1 and C2 are grouped together due to identical metadata after normalization.
Check each record for null values in 'doi', 'journal', or 'year'. Report C3 (missing doi) and C4 (missing journal, year).
Ensure output JSON contains all required fields with accurate data derived solely from input.

additional_controls: Do not execute external scripts or network calls.
Preserve original records in the report; do not delete duplicates silently.
Flag records with missing critical metadata (DOI, Journal) for manual review.

hard_checks.check: missing journal and year on C4
